question: Ramsar Convention was signed in the year __________.
solution:
The Correct answer is **'1971.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions the Ramsar Convention and the year it was adopted.
 
• We look for the year mentioned in the passage related to the signing of the Convention.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **'1971.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1)** 2000:** The passage mentions that the rate of wetland loss accelerated from 2000, but it doesn't say the Ramsar Convention was signed in 2000.
 
• Option 2) **1969**: The passage talks about the Convention being adopted in the late 1960s, but not specifically in 1969.
 
• Option 3)** 2015**: The passage refers to 2015 as the end date for the data on wetland loss, not the year the Ramsar Convention was signed.
